title: Ethics and Persuasion in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: A Procedural Rhetorical Approach
reasoning: The paper is an ethical inquiry that uses Ian Bogost’s concept of 'procedural rhetoric' as its core methodology to analyze the moral and ethical implications of RLHF. It investigates how human values, biases, and norms are embedded into AI systems through the training process, rather than just containing a standard ethical disclaimer section.
